title_zh: 悬疑剧：昏暗房间里的秘密
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (9/20): Secrets in a Dim Room
note_en: Doubling 一点 into 一点点 (yìdiǎndiǎn) turns "a little" into "little by little": 随着线索一点点被发现 "as the clues are uncovered bit by bit." The doubled form works as an adverb of gradual change placed right before the verb, where English needs a whole phrase like "bit by bit." 一步步 "step by step" and 一天天 "day by day" follow the same pattern.
